{{Quote|If she's hiring a skyhook for this party, she must be filthy rich.''"<br />"''Rich, yes, but you'll find nothing filthy about her.|Gavin Darklighter and Asyr Sei'lar|<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
'''Liska Dan'kre''' was a wealthy [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]].

==Biography==
Born to a wealthy Bothan family, Dan'kre attended school with [[Asyr Sei'lar]], whom she befriended. Sei'lar, something of a rebel, transferred out of that school to the [[Bothan Martial Academy|Bothan Military Academy]], but the two remained friends.

After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] conquered [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Dan'kre moved to the world. Shortly after its conquest, she hosted a party on a luxurious [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], to which Sei'lar was invited. She was delighted to reunite with Sei'lar, who was making a name for herself in [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. She was also impressed by Sei'lar's boyfriend, [[Gavin Darklighter]]. The fact that Darklighter was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] excited mild disapproval among many of the guests, but Dan'kre easily accepted him. Dan'kre eagerly caught up with her old friend at the party, though a slight commotion was made when [[Karka Kre'fey]] challenged Darklighter to a duel after Darklighter honestly answered Kre'fey when asked if the Bothan's grandfather, [[Laryn Kre'fey]], had fouled up at the [[First Battle of Borleias]]. Darklighter declined.
